question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        t_home.team_api_id as team_api_id,
        t_home.team_long_name as team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
                 WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
                 ELSE 0 END) as points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t_home ON m.home_team_api_id = t_home.team_api_id
    GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, t_home.team_api_id, t_home.team_long_name
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        t_away.team_api_id as team_api_id,
        t_away.team_long_name as team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
                 WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
                 ELSE 0 END) as points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t_away ON m.away_team_api_id = t_away.team_api_id
    GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, t_away.team_api_id, t_away.team_long_name
),
team_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        team_name,
        SUM(points)::INTEGER as total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id, team_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        team_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT 
    r.season,
    t.team_long_name as team_name,
    l.name as league,
    c.name as country,
    r.total_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN Team t ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON r.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON r.country_id = c.id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.season, r.league_id
